title: Who was in Larkin's band: Illinois Jacquet comes and goes
summary: Pushed to return to Larkin, Cobb says he preceded Illinois Jacquet, who left for California in 1940 on a family railroad pass and was picked up by Hampton.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

And I tell you how Illinois left. See, his dad worked for Southern Pacific railroad, and all the kids up to a certain age had passes to take vacations, and so this year Russell, his brother ...
He's the trumpet player.

This was in 1940 -- he went to California on vacation, and Mae went, his sister. Mae and Russell came back but Illinois stayed out there. That's when Lionel Hampton picked him up, and formed his band.
